problem.cursorExpired: This page link expired. Reload the timeline.
problem.badIds: Some selected contacts aren't valid ids.
problem.listGone: That list doesn't exist in this workspace.
problem.scopeLists: Your role is limited to other lists.
problem.suppressReason: Say why these contacts are suppressed; it goes to the audit log.
problem.noSystemProvider: No sending provider is connected to the System stream, so opt-in emails can't go out yet. Connect one in Sending providers.

problem.eraseConfirm.note: n: the number of contacts, which the person types to confirm

problem.smsConsentFilter: Pick any, none or a list of this workspace.
problem.filterList: Pick a list from this workspace.
problem.filterSegment: Pick a segment from this workspace.

problem.notLanguageClosest.message: {value} isn't a language. Did you mean {name} ({code})?
problem.notLanguageClosest.note: value: what was typed, in quotes; name and code: the closest language, like Spanish (es)

problem.notLanguage.message: {value} isn't a language. Use a code such as es-MX, or a language's name such as Spanish.
problem.notLanguage.note: value: what was typed, in quotes. Language names are read in English, so keep Spanish as is

problem.languageFilter.message: Pick one of your languages, “none” or “not_offered”.
problem.languageFilter.note: none and not_offered are values of the filter, never translated

problem.notDeleted.note: name: a list's name, in quotes

problem.restoreExpired.message: Deleted lists can be restored for {days} days; {name} is past that.
problem.restoreExpired.note: days: 30; name: the list's name, in quotes

problem.restoreNameTaken.message: Another list is called {name} now. Rename it, then restore this one.
problem.restoreNameTaken.note: name: the list's name, in quotes

problem.listExists.note: name: the list's name, in quotes

problem.fieldKey: Keys use lowercase letters, digits and _, and start with a letter (for example signup_source).

problem.fieldBuiltin.note: key: a field's key, like email

problem.fieldMoney: Only number fields can show as money.

problem.fieldExists.message: A field with the key {key} already exists.
problem.fieldExists.note: key: a custom field's key, like plan

problem.paidNeedsEarn: Your role can't see paid members, so it can't filter by paid status.

problem.policyActive.note: Active, At risk, Cooling and Sunset are the engagement tiers

problem.policyAtRisk.message: At risk must start after {days} days so Cooling has room.

problem.policySunset.message: Sunset must start after At risk ({days} days).

problem.policyStop: Stop Broadcasts at least 1 day after Sunset.

problem.fieldNumber.message: {key} is a number field; {value} isn't a number.
problem.fieldNumber.note: key: a custom field's key; value: what was typed, in quotes

problem.fieldDate.message: {key} is a date field; use a date like 2026-10-30.
problem.fieldDate.note: key: a custom field's key; the date shows the format to type, keep it as is

problem.fieldRealDate.note: key: a custom field's key; value: what was typed, in quotes

problem.fieldBoolean.message: {key} is a yes/no field; use true or false.
problem.fieldBoolean.note: key: a custom field's key; true and false are values to type, never translated

problem.fieldSelect.note: key: a custom field's key; options: its values, joined with commas

problem.timezone.message: {value} isn't a timezone. Use a name like America/Chicago.
problem.timezone.note: value: what was typed, in quotes; America/Chicago is a timezone name, never translated

problem.notCustomField.message: {key} isn't a custom field. Create it first under Fields.
problem.notCustomField.note: key: what was sent as a custom field's key

problem.emailInvalid.note: problem: one of the email.* phrases, like no domain

problem.contactSuppressed.message: {email} is on the suppression list ({reason}). Remove it there first if they gave you a new opt-in.
problem.contactSuppressed.note: reason: one of the reason.* names, like Hard bounce

problem.contactExists: {email} is already a contact. Open their profile to change lists.
problem.optinSuppressed: {email} is on the suppression list, so no opt-in email can be sent.
problem.optinCooldown: A confirmation email went to {email} a few minutes ago, or five already went today. Try again after {time}.
problem.alreadySuppressed: {email} is already on the suppression list.
problem.filterStore: Pick a store from this workspace.
problem.suppressionSource: Pick a source from the list.

problem.csvUnreadable.note: file: the file's name; error: what the CSV reader reported, in English

problem.uploadTooMany: Upload at most 100,000 addresses at a time.
problem.uploadEmpty: The file has no addresses. Put them in a column named email.

email.noDomain.note: in problem.emailInvalid: That isn't an email address (no domain).

label.anEmail.note: a timeline event's email when its campaign or automation is gone: Delivered an email

label.mailboxOther.note: a mailbox provider other than Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo and iCloud; Other · Google Workspace

label.importerOther.note: an import from a tool ReputeCast doesn't name

tier.active.note: the engagement tiers: Active, Cooling, At risk, Sunset

failure.suppressed.message: on the suppression list ({reason}); needs a new opt-in
failure.suppressed.note: reason: a reason.* name in lower case, like hard bounce

failure.refused: the System provider refused the email
failure.cooldown: a confirmation email went to this address in the last 10 minutes, or five went today
note.alreadySuppressed: {count, plural, other {# were already on the suppression list.}}

source.preference_center.note: where a consent change came from, inside a sentence: Unsubscribed in the preference center

source.checkout.note: source: a store's name, like Shopify

suppressionSource.export.note: a group of imported suppressions named after the tool's export file: Brevo export

pulled.events.note: after a number: 12 from its bounces and complaints (a provider without a suppression API)

skipped.noAnswer.note: error: the provider's own error, in English

insight.repermission.message: The {name} drives most of the {mailbox} complaints. Sending them a re-permission email, then suppressing non-responders, usually fixes it within two sends.
insight.repermission.note: name: a list's or saved view's name, like Mailchimp import; mailbox: a mailbox provider, like Outlook

insight.repermissionAll.message: The {name} drives most of the complaints. Sending them a re-permission email, then suppressing non-responders, usually fixes it within two sends.
insight.repermissionAll.note: name: a list's or saved view's name, like Mailchimp import

insight.attention.message: {name} needs attention: check its bounce and complaint rates and what changed in recent sends to it.
insight.attention.note: name: a list's or saved view's name

note.addedByTeam.note: a consent event's note: a member added the contacts to a list

note.confirmationSent: confirmation sent via the System stream

detail.frequencyAll.note: how often a subscriber chose to get emails, in the preference center

detail.paused.message: for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, until {until, date}
